description.fun: A snow leopard sculpted from snow, whose two fangs are the halves of a broken sword. That sword is its true self, brought to life by the hatred of those who died by it long ago. For all that, it's playful: it can control 100 tons of snow and leaps in and out of the avalanches it causes. With sword pieces for fangs, it's a literal sabre-toothed cat.
description.guide: A Dark and Ice-type Legendary Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, one of the four treasures of ruin. Its true form is the broken sword that makes up its fangs, and it can control huge amounts of snow. It is known as the Sword of Ruin.
description.tagline: A snow leopard whose fangs are the halves of a broken sword
